text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF CHRONIC OTITIS MEDIA
- Main complaints: recurrent ear discharge (mucoid in simple type; thick and
foul-smelling in serious type) and increasing deafness
- Pain is uncommon
- Central eardrum perforation is of varying size may occur
- Cholesteatoma and marginal or attic perforation is seen in the serious type
